Images.Action.EditTip: Open in the image editor — edits are kept beside the image until you save them into it
Images.Action.RevertEditsTip: Remove this image's edits, so it shows as it is on disk
Images.Action.RevertConfirmOneFormat: Remove the edits made to '{0}'? The image itself is unchanged.
Images.Action.RevertConfirmManyFormat: Remove the edits made to {0} images? The images themselves are unchanged.
Images.Companion.EditedTip: Edited — the edits are kept beside the image and shown whenever it is viewed
Images.Toolbar.CarouselTip: Carousel — one image at a time
Images.Toolbar.ExploreTip: Explore — thumbnails left, selected image right
Images.Toolbar.CollageTip: Collage — scattered canvas (drag to pan, wheel to zoom)
Images.Toolbar.EditTip: Edit this image (E) — edits are kept beside it and shown whenever it is viewed; the file changes only when you save
Images.Toolbar.VideoTip: Make a short video that starts from this picture
Images.Toolbar.ConvertToMarkdownTip: Read this page of writing into a Markdown document, opened in the right-hand pane: its columns as one text, its formulas as LaTeX, its tables and figures
Images.MakeVideo.Heading: Make a video from this picture
Images.MakeVideo.Note: It starts from the picture as you see it, edits and all. It's made in the background — under the background tasks — and opens when it's done.
Images.Tools.ToggleFit: Toggle fit to window / actual size
Images.FullScreen.Hint: Esc exit · Space / → next · ← previous · click to navigate
Images.Edit.EditedTip: This image has edits, shown as they would be saved. The file itself is unchanged until you save.
Images.Edit.CompareTip: Show the image as it is on disk, to compare
Images.Edit.RevertTip: Remove every edit and go back to the original (undoable)
Images.Edit.SaveTip: Write the edits into this file (Ctrl+S)
Images.Edit.SaveCopyTip: Write the edited image to a new file, leaving this one as it is (Ctrl+Shift+S)
Images.Edit.DoneTip: Leave editing (Esc) — the edits stay, shown whenever the image is viewed
Images.Edit.Tool.AdjustTip: Exposure, contrast, highlights, shadows and colour
Images.Edit.Tool.MarkupTip: Arrows, boxes, text, pen and highlighter
Images.Edit.Tool.CutOutTip: Pick something out of the photo and copy or save it without its background
Images.Edit.Tool.ResizeTip: The size the image is saved at
Images.Edit.Crop.PortraitTip: Hold the aspect upright rather than across
Images.Edit.Crop.LevelTip: Drag along something that should be level (or upright) and the image is straightened to match
Images.Edit.Crop.Hint: Drag the handles or the frame. Enter applies, Esc goes back to how the crop was.
Images.Edit.Adjust.AutoTip: Set the sliders from the image — every one adjustable after
Images.Edit.Restore.EnhanceTip: Clean up softness, noise and JPEG blocks with the picture tools, before the sliders apply
Images.Edit.Restore.UpscaleNote: Made larger by the picture tools, detail restored rather than stretched. Turns AI enhance on.
Images.Restore.NeedsTool: AI enhance needs the picture tools — a {0} download.
Images.Restore.Unavailable: This photo is set to AI enhance, which this machine can't run; it's shown as it was.
Images.RemoveBackground.NeedsTool: Removing the background needs picture selection — a {0} download.
Images.RemoveBackground.Unavailable: This photo is set to have its background removed, which this machine can't do; it's shown whole.
Images.CutOut.Hint: Click the thing to keep, right-click what to leave out, or drag a box round it — or name it and press Find.
Images.CutOut.Picked: Picked. Click to add to it, right-click to take away from it.
Images.CutOut.NothingThere: Nothing stands out there — click on the thing itself.
Images.CutOut.NeedsTool: Cut out needs picture selection — a {0} download.
Images.CutOut.Unavailable: This machine can't run picture selection.
Images.CutOut.FindTip: Pick out everything these words name
Images.CutOut.CopyTip: Copy what is picked, without its background
Images.CutOut.SaveTip: Save what is picked as a PNG, transparent around it
Images.CutOut.Copied: The cut-out is on the clipboard.
Images.CutOut.RemoveBackgroundTip: Keep only what is picked, in the photo itself; everything else becomes transparent
Images.Edit.Markup.Hint: Annotations stay on what they mark when the crop changes. Select one to move it or change its style.
Images.Edit.Export.StripHint: Removes camera details, location, dates and descriptions (EXIF, XMP, IPTC). The colour profile always stays.
Images.Edit.Export.QualityHint: Higher keeps more detail and makes larger files.
Images.Edit.Export.Hint: Save writes the edits into this file. Save as copy writes a new file in the format its name asks for.
Images.Edit.Notice.SourceChanged: This image has changed since its edits were made. Keep the edits on the new image, or discard them?
Images.Edit.Notice.Archive: This image is inside an archive, so its edits last only while it is open here. Use Save as copy to keep them.
Images.Edit.Notice.Newer: This image's edits were made by a newer version of Nexaflow, so it is shown unedited and they are left as they are. Edits made here are not kept.
Images.Edit.Notice.Unreadable: This image's edits file can't be read, so it is shown unedited and the file is left as it is. Edits made here are not kept.
Images.Edit.Save.ConfirmMessageFormat: Write the edits into '{0}'? The original pixels are replaced. Save as copy keeps them.
Images.Edit.Save.NoteArchive: This image is inside an archive, so it can only be saved as a copy.
Images.Edit.Save.NoteAnimated: This image is animated; saving would keep only its first frame, so it can only be saved as a copy.
Images.Edit.Save.NoteFormatFormat: {0} images can't be written here, so this one can only be saved as a copy.
Images.Edit.Save.NoteNoTransparencyForma: {0} files can't be transparent, so with its background removed this photo can only be saved as a copy — as PNG or WebP.
Images.Edit.Save.NoteNoMetadataFormat: {0} files have no place for camera details or location, so saving drops them.
